EnglishRequirementLink:
We recognise the following English language qualifications:

GCSE pass in English at Grade C or above
IELTS with an overall score of 6.0 with at least 5.5 in each component (including One Skill Retake)*. Please note that for those students who do not require a UKVI SELT, USW will also be able to accept the IELTS online test
TOEFL iBT (Including Home Edition):
-For exams taken before January 21, 2026:
Minimum total score: 72
Minimum section scores: Reading: 18, Listening: 17, Writing: 17, Speaking: 20
-For exams taken on or after January 21, 2026:
Minimum total score: 4
Minimum section scores: Reading: 4, Listening: 4, Writing: 4, Speaking: 4
Please note we do not accept My Best Scores
Duolingo English Test - 110 overall and 100 in each component for standard entry. Please note that the overall scores shown above are only indicative of the score required and additional checks on test samples may be required. The Duolingo English Test must have been completed within two years of the proposed visa application submission date
Cambridge English: Advanced (CAE): exams taken from January 2015 – overall score of 169 with at least 162 in each component; exams taken before January 2015 – Grade C and no less than borderline in each skill 
Trinity College English Language qualifications: ISE II Distinction or ISE III Pass
IELCA
-Direct entry: 32 overall score, no less that 30 in each component
-Direct entry needing a higher IELTS score: 35 overall, no less than 30 in each component
PTE Academic and PTE Academic UKVI with a score of 59 overall and 59 in each component. Please note this must be taken at a PTE test centre
Language Cert Academic or Language Cert Academic (SELT) with a minimum score of 65 overall, with a minimum of 60 in each component. Please note that the online version of the Language Cert test is not accepted
PSI Service (UK) Ltd Skills for English UKVI B2 (4 component) with a pass in all 4 components (listening, speaking, reading writing)
Kaplan Test of English online test: Overall score of 458, with 425 in each component
Password Skills Plus with an overall score of 6.0 and no less than 5.5 in each component
Language Cert International ESOL B2 Communicator exam with a High Pass overall and a minimum of 38 in speaking and 33 in all other components. Please note we do not accept the online version of this test
Oxford Test of English (OTE) with a score of 125 overall and 111 in each component
For doctoral and research masters courses a minimum of IELTS 6.5 overall is required (with a minimum of 5.5 in each band) or regional equivalents. Evidence of a UK Masters (for doctoral level) or UK undergraduate degree (for research masters) are also acceptable
*Please note that a very small number of USW’s programmes require a higher IELTS (or equivalent) score. Please see the individual course pages for details.
ScholarshipLink:
International Office Scholarships worth up to £2,000 are available for students who are self-funding their studies.

You will be automatically be considered for one of these awards when we receive your application. 

Undergraduate (including top-ups): up to £1,500

Postgraduate: up to £2,000  International Development Scholarships of £2,500 are available for students from the following regions, for undergraduate and postgraduate courses:

Africa
Latin America
South Asia
South East Asia
Central Asia and Turkey
Caribbean
Lebanon
Bahrain 
Norway
Albania
Please visit our Chancellors International Development Scholarship page to see if you are eligible to receive this scholarship.

This scholarship replaces the standard undergraduate and postgraduate scholarships. Higher National Diploma students and Foundation Degree students are not eligible for the Chancellor’s International Development Scholarship.How it works
You will be automatically considered for a scholarship when you make your application. You do not need to make a separate scholarship application. You will receive confirmation of a scholarship with your offer letter.

Scholarships and discounts do not apply to sponsored students or those studying a placement year or English language programmes.

Scholarships may be withdrawn if conditions of the scholarships are not adhered toStudents who are CAS ready in CAS Shield by May 31st for the September 2026 intake, or, by 31st October for the January/February 2027 intake, will be eligible for an extra £500 scholarship, on top of an existing USW scholarship. This scholarship applies to each year of study - except for students who have been awarded the EU Scholarship, who are not eligible for this enhancement.

How does this work?

Your student record needs to be CAS ready by May 31st for the September 2026 intake or CAS ready by 31st October for the January/February 2027 intake.
What does CAS ready mean? You have fully completed CAS Shield with all relevant documents and your deposit has cleared.
Students who are CAS ready by 31st May for the September 2026 intake will receive an additional £500 scholarship added to their CAS. 
E.G if you have applied for MSc Management with a £2,500 Chancellor’s International Development Scholarship, you will receive a £2,500 scholarship on your offer letter. However, if you receive a CAS by 31st May, the scholarship will be £3,000 instead.

The Early CAS scholarship excludes ACCA courses, MBA Global Advanced Entry, DBA, PhD, MPhil, Masters by Research and any pre-sessional or pathway provider course.

Note that you may also be eligible for an extra Early Payment Discount of £300. In order to qualify for this discount, you must pay the balance of your course fee for the year to the University no later than 14 calendar days after the start date of your course as indicated on your offer letter.If you are a self-funding full-time undergraduate or postgraduate student, you may be eligible for an Early Payment Discount of £300. In order to qualify for this discount, you must pay the balance of your course fee for the year to the University no later than 14 calendar days after the start date of your course as indicated on your offer letter. Terms and conditions apply – more information available here.

Please note: Students who have been awarded the EU Scholarship are not eligible for the Early Payment Discount.
